purpose: Distinguish general profiler failure from packed-kernel profiling failure and attempt hardware counters with application range replay.
instrumentation: ECC_PROFILE_RANGE=1 adds cudaProfilerStart/Stop around a synchronized packed walk launch. It defaults off. These builds never supply throughput samples.
arithmetic: Unmodified native control arithmetic; MINBLOCKS=2, square=0, Karatsuba3=0, BATCH=16
smokeWorkload: 4096 independent 1024-step unsigned LCG results checked against CPU; one GPU-duration metric with kernel replay and application range replay
packedRange: Second marked walk launch, 32 steps, at 385024 and 96256 workers. Three hardware sections: SpeedOfLight, MemoryWorkloadAnalysis, ComputeWorkloadAnalysis. Cache flush enabled; clocks unchanged.
correctness: GPU arithmetic/storage/sigma probes plus checkpoint/restart and reference-report integration for the instrumented client
success: Both packed ranges return success and produce usable ncu reports; inspect numeric counters before any bottleneck claim.
failure: Retain exact errors and smoke results; do not infer counters or substitute profiler durations for throughput.
cloudLimit: One benchmark GPU, 45-minute workload, 50-minute controller, independent 55-minute shutdown, exact-ID termination.
